countdown.heading: The countdown
events.heading: Where you'll be
rsvp.heading: Will you be there?
rsvp.sub: One tap is all it takes. You can change your mind later.
rsvp.yesDone: Wonderful! We've saved you a seat (and a plate).
rsvp.noDone: We'll miss you! Expect a very dramatic photo update.
faq.heading: Frequently asked (and mostly answered)
faq.a1: Yes. Come hungry, leave in a food coma.
faq.a2: Look good. The photographer is watching. (Real details are in the events above.)
faq.q3: Do I need to bring a gift?
faq.a3: Your presence is the gift. An envelope is also very good presence.
faq.a4: Rumours say yes. We'll let you decide.
faq.a5: Yes, and so is the chaos that comes with them.
faq.q6: What time should I actually arrive?
faq.a6: Indian Standard Time is a lovely concept. The ceremony, however, starts on time.
faq.q7: What if I cry during the ceremony?
faq.a7: Tissues are provided. Dignity is not.
footer.credits: Made with love, chai and far too many spreadsheets.
